Name: Jio Alternate Marriage Dialogue
Author: tiakall
Description:
When marrying Jio from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7286]Ridgeside Village[/url], he goes from being a slightly awkward and emotionally distant warrior to a poet who speaks in flowery language and showers you with affection.  And many people love that about him!  But I wanted to do something that I felt fit his pre-marriage characterization a bit more closely.  My take on Jio won't read you sonnets, call you sweet pet names, or lavish you with descriptions of your beauty. But he'll slowly let himself become more vulnerable to you, learn about you, and try his best to adapt to civilian lifestyle so he's worthy of you. I think that's pretty romantic!

(He'll still read a little poetry.)

This mod adds 20 lines of randomized dialogue while dating, as well as an additional 150+ when married, including edits to festivals and day-specific dialogue.

Future plans may include a couple of exclusive events or a custom wedding. We'll see!
